Please tell me you've got units to detect it by now..|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 17 (Formerly, [[Headache Headquarters]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Pro Streamer''' was a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Hidden Boss]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every [[Hidden Boss]] modern variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a high amount of health and a fast speed. Additionally, as it is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, only towers with hidden detection can target it. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Pro Streamer''' has pale skin and blue hair. It wears a blue shirt and pants. On the shirt, four words can be seen, being “Eat”, “Sleep”, “Game” and “Repeat”. It also has a yellow headband. It also has an image of a ''Fortnite'' [[w:c:fortnite:Assault Rifle|Assault Rifle]] on the back of its shirt. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Pro Streamer''' is similar to the second version, except on its face, it has an image of [[wp:Ninja (gamer)|Ninja]]. }} ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively. *As its quite fast, stalling towers like the [[Brawler]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]] or [[Freezer]] can be quite useful. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} ProStreamer.png|First version (1 April 2024 – 23 January 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1ProStreamer.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseProStreamer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ProStreamerIconIG.png|'''Pro Streamer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Pro Streamer''' is based on [[wp:Ninja (gamer)|Ninja]], a popular streamer. **Its replacement of the [[Hidden Boss]] may be a reference to the [[Ninja]], a removed [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' - [[v1.17.2]] **'''Pro Streamer''' added. *'''8 April 2024''' - [[v1.18.0]]b **'''Pro Streamer''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Pro Streamer''' re-added, exclusively to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''23 January 2025''' **{{Bug}} Face removed, as the original decal has been moderated and removed by Roblox. *'''1 April 2025''' - [[v1.58.0|v1.58.1a]] **'''Pro Streamer''' now appears in [[Headache Headquarters]] as part of [[April Fools 2025 Event]]. *'''8 April 2025''' - [[v1.59.0|v1.59.6b]] **'''Pro Streamer''' no longer appears in [[Headache Headquarters]], now only appears in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{HeadacheHQ|[[Megatron Toilet]]|Wave 16|Pro Streamer|Wave 17|[[Arrow]]|Wave 19}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
